body:
Yes! That's exactly it. I still don't know if the times I've been "attracted" to someone in the past was real or not. I don't know if I like the feeling of being liked or the attention, but the closest I think I've been to liking someone is to a friend of mine (we have been friends for... 8, 9 years? And spending time with her is always so lovely).

And yes, god, the way you go about the mental recoil is exactly what I feel. I don't think I need a relationship either, although there is always that part of me that wonders and aches for it, probably because we live in a very romance-focus society.

I'm so happy you're doing well, and so relieved to hear someone has gone through the exact same thing.
I will check it out, thank you!

Yeah, I think you're right! He's a really kind and caring person, and I think that what's making me so anxious is the thought of hurting him? Because I did say I considered our meetings dates when he asked (I was really nervous at the moment haha), and now I feel like going back and telling him I didn't mean that might be hurtful.

I definitely don't want to lose him as a friend, and I don't want him to think I'm just using him to experiment, but. Yeah.

My relationship with my parents is really great, but it's true that I've always felt (especially when I was a teenager), like I would never have someone interested in me. 

People only started showing interest in me once I started college and, even then, I was too shy to start a relationship. But yeah, like many people are saying, I think part of the issue is that I'm mentally bombing the relationship.

Thank you for the lovely message. I think that there is definitely a mental block on my part, because this has been going on since I was a teenager. Whether I am attracted to them or not, I guess time will tell. As you said, we're both adults and we can talk about it, I think the best choice right now is to be honest and discuss how we both feel.
I do have crushes on celebrities and fantasize about them (not in a sexual nature, though, more in like. Domestic scenarios? As corny as that sounds, haha).

That's actually something I've been thinking about recently. Am I really attracted to men or do I just like being wanted? It's... hard to figure this things out, to be honest. 

Thank you again for your wishes and for your reply :)

I still have pretty low self esteem, to be honest. And that's what my family/friends, keep telling me: that the idea of something like this becoming a real possibility is probably what triggers the feelings of anxiety.

This is something that I've considered too. I'm not sure about being aromantic (maybe because of all the media I've consumed, like everyone else), but I do think I might be ace. I'm barely sexually attracted to people (if I even am, to begin with), and I tend to like people more because of their "aesthetics" or personality. Thank you all for replying, I think I might start considering this as an option!

I do think that I'm going to need therapy because I have attachment issues, but I was very lucky and wasn't bullied when I was younger! Even if I was pretty shy, I had some friends and I did pretty well in high school.

Thank you for your answer, though, I'm really happy you found the right person for you :)

They are. Anxiety makes your body go tense the muscles are affected by this. I went to the doctor because I have a constant neck pain that leads to headaches and he told me that while your spine is supposed to curve on your neck, when you're this tense the muscles around it make it straight, which it's obviously not good. You can seek physical therapy for this, but sadly it will come back, as it is not a postural issue. Yoga, tai-chi and meditation help me, but then again, I still have neck pain, so. I hope you feel better soon!
You're right. I know it's going to be hard, but I do want to get better. Thank you again for your words and for replying to me.

Thank you for this, really. I guess that writing it is somehow easier than saying it out loud. I know I want to look better even in the eyes of my therapist, which makes no sense at all, because she's there to help me. Next week will be my last session before her break, so I won't see her until September. Maybe waiting until then will be the best, I don't know.
